# Getting help

- **Using Wheelie:** start with the [README](../README.md) and the [installation guide](../docs/installation.md).
- **Something is broken:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/Shazaanashraff/wheelie/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Want something new:** [open a feature request](https://github.com/Shazaanashraff/wheelie/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security problem:** do not open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
